name: codedock
description: Codedock self-hosted PaaS control plane & monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:daemon
scripts.check: go fmt ./cmd/... ./internal/... ./tests/... && go vet ./cmd/... ./internal/... ./tests/... && npm run format
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@codedock/dashboard && npm run typecheck --workspace=@codedock/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@codedock/sdk && npm run typecheck --workspace=@codedock/setup && npm run typecheck --workspace=@codedock/ui
scripts.test: go test ./cmd/... ./internal/... ./tests/... && npm run test --workspace=@codedock/dashboard && npm run test --workspace=@codedock/sdk && npm run test --workspace=@codedock/setup && npm run test --workspace=@codedock/ui
scripts.docker:up: docker network create codedock-network 2>/dev/null || true && docker run -d --name codedock-control-plane --restart unless-stopped -p 8080:8080 -v codedock_data:/codedock/data -e CODEDOCK_DATA_DIR=/codedock/data -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro --network codedock-network ghcr.io/buildwithtechx/codedock:dev
scripts.docker:down: docker stop codedock-control-plane && docker rm codedock-control-plane
